title: Checkpoint content (checkpoint/0)
description: The content.inline of a store checkpoint: the size of the log it covers, the entry hash at that size and the RFC 9162 Merkle tree hash over the canonical entries 1 to size. A witness attestation by the store key signs the checkpoint object. Rules the schema cannot express (size below the checkpoint's own seq, head and root agreeing with the log, the shape of the checkpoint object around this content) are in spec/store-0.md.

size.description: The number of entries covered: the seq of the last entry before the checkpoint's own entry.

head.description: The entry hash of seq = size.

root.description: The RFC 9162 Merkle Tree Hash over leaves 1 to size, where leaf n is the canonical bytes of entry n.
